doc.title: Annie Ross interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001

title: Money and the trio's partnership
summary: She was unhappy with the financial return because they lacked lawyers, but values the music and the equal three-way partnership.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: I’m curious if the albums that you guys did, were you happy with the financial return?

No. No. See in those days, we didn’t know about lawyers, and we didn’t know about you consult your lawyer before you sign anything. So no, I wasn’t happy with that. But hey, the music was so great, what came out of it, money couldn’t buy.
That’s for sure. It kept your writing skills pretty sharp.
A little, yeah. I left most of it to Jon. But it was a wonderful thing because it wasn’t founded by any one person, it was the three of us as one.
You were quite hard to replace I would have to say.
